patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（, forcing …）

1.explanation_zh: 「從未學過法律的一般民眾」用關係子句放在名詞後面：ordinary citizens who have never studied law（先行詞是人用 who，複數用 have）。「和職業法官一起審判重大刑案並不容易」中文以動作當主詞，英文最自然的寫法是虛主詞 it is not easy to judge serious criminal cases together with professional judges，也可以用動名詞 Judging … is not easy。前面有 For … 時，後面一定要補主詞 it，不能直接用 is 開頭。
evidence: 從未學過法律的一般民眾
1.strategy_zh: 「對…來說，做某事並不容易」固定寫成 For + N, it is not easy to VR …；「從未…過的人」用 who have never + p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：對從未學過法律的一般民眾來說／和職業法官一起／審判重大刑案／並不容易
標的詞彙：ordinary（一般的）、citizen（民眾）、study（學習）、law（法律）、professional（職業的）、judge（法官、審判）、serious（重大的）、criminal（刑事的）、case（案件）、easy（容易的）
句型框架：For + N + who have never p.p. …, it is not easy to VR … together with + N.

2.explanation_zh: 「決定別人命運的壓力」中心名詞是「壓力」：the pressure of deciding other people's fate（of 後面接動名詞）。「比想像中大得多」用比較級 is much greater than expected，加強比較級用 much／far，不用 very。「迫使一些國民法官尋求心理諮商」是前面情況造成的結果，中文沒有主詞，英文用句尾分詞 , forcing some citizen judges to seek counseling；seek 直接接受詞，不加 for。
evidence: 迫使一些國民法官（citizen judges）尋求心理諮商
2.strategy_zh: 「…的壓力」先找中心名詞 pressure，再用 of + V-ing 補上內容；「比想像中…得多」用 much + 比較級 + than expected。
hints: 切成四段：此外，決定別人命運的壓力／比想像中大得多／迫使一些國民法官（citizen judges）／尋求心理諮商
標的詞彙：pressure（壓力）、decide（決定）、fate（命運）、expect（預期）、force（迫使）、judge（法官）、seek（尋求）、counseling（心理諮商）
句型框架：Moreover, the pressure of V-ing … + is much greater than expected, forcing + O + to VR …

bonus.explanation_zh: laypeople（沒有專業背景的一般人）、anything but easy（一點也不容易）是進階用字；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 中文「和職業法官一起審判重大刑案並不容易」以動作當主詞，英文用虛主詞 It is not easy to judge …（或動名詞 Judging … is not easy）；「從未學過法律的一般民眾」修飾語很長，改成後位的關係子句 citizens who have never studied law。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：「對…來說」For（To）＋ordinary／average citizens（people、members of the public）＋who have never studied (learned) law，寫 who have never received legal training 也可以；「和職業法官一起」together with／alongside／along with／with professional judges；「審判重大刑案」judge／try／decide／hear／handle／rule on + serious／major criminal cases（虛主詞句用 to judge …，動名詞主詞句用 judging …）；「並不容易」用虛主詞 it is not easy to …，或以動名詞片語當主詞 Judging … is not easy（is no easy task、is not an easy task、is difficult 也給分），兩種都算達成本句 NFSUBJ 標的。另外也給分：who have never learned about law、who have no legal background、who have never had any legal training；寫成 It is not easy for ordinary citizens who have never studied law to judge … 也可以。

common_errors.explanation_zh: seek（尋求）是及物動詞，直接接受詞，不加 for。
「心理諮商」是 psychological counseling；psychology 是學科名稱，不能直接修飾 consultation。

traps.literal_error: Moreover, the pressure of decide other people's fate is much greater than expected, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「決定別人命運的壓力」中心是「壓力」：the pressure of + 動名詞 deciding …；of 後面不能接原形動詞。

traps.literal_error: …forcing some citizen judges to seek for psychology consultation.
traps.explanation_zh: seek 直接接受詞（seek counseling），不加 for；「心理諮商」是 psychological counseling。

bonus.text: Little did many citizen judges expect that deciding someone else's fate would weigh so heavily on them, and some have even had to seek counseling.
bonus.explanation_zh: Little did + S + expect … 是否定副詞置首的倒裝，表示「完全沒想到」；weigh heavily on sb（沉重地壓在某人心上）是進階搭配。這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「迫使一些國民法官…」前面沒有主詞，用句尾分詞 , forcing some citizen judges to …；「決定別人命運的壓力」以「壓力」為中心，寫成 the pressure of deciding …（of＋動名詞）。
2.notes_zh: 評分說明：「此外」Moreover／In addition／Besides／Furthermore／What's more；「決定別人命運的壓力」the pressure／stress／burden of deciding (determining) other people's fate(s)、someone else's fate、the fate of others；「比想像中大得多」is much／far greater／bigger／heavier than expected（than they (had) expected／imagined、than they thought）；「迫使」forcing／compelling／pushing／driving，寫成 , which forces／has forced some citizen judges to …（which 指前面整件事）也算達成本句 PART 標的；「一些國民法官」some (of the) citizen judges；「尋求心理諮商」seek／get／receive (psychological／professional) counseling（英式拼法 counselling 也可以）、seek help from counselors、turn to counselors for help。另外也給分：someone's fate、others' destinies、the fates of others；seek mental (health) counseling、see a psychologist／therapist、seek professional help、seek psychological support。

1.translation: It is not easy for ordinary citizens who have never studied law to try serious criminal cases together with professional judges.
1.explanation_zh: 「對…來說…並不容易」用 It is not easy for … to V；「從未學過法律的」用關係子句配現在完成式 who have never studied law；「審判」用法律用語 try；「重大刑案」譯 serious criminal cases。

2.translation: Moreover, the pressure of deciding other people's fate is much greater than expected, forcing some citizen judges to seek psychological counseling.
2.explanation_zh: 「決定別人命運的壓力」用 the pressure of deciding …；「比想像中大得多」用 much greater than expected（也可 than one might imagine）；「迫使」用分詞構句 forcing … to seek。

1.translation: For ordinary people who have never studied law, it is not easy to try serious criminal cases together with professional judges.
1.explanation_zh: 「從未學過法律的一般民眾」用 ordinary people who have never studied law，以現在完成式表示經驗；句子用虛主詞 it is not easy to ...；「審判重大刑案」為 try serious criminal cases；「和職業法官一起」為 together with professional judges。

2.translation: In addition, the pressure of deciding other people's fates is much greater than one would imagine, forcing some citizen judges to seek psychological counseling.
2.explanation_zh: 「比想像中大得多」譯為 much greater than one would imagine（亦可用 than expected），much 強調比較級；「迫使一些國民法官尋求心理諮商」用分詞構句 forcing some citizen judges to seek psychological counseling；「此外」用 In addition。「命運」用複數 fates 或單數 fate 皆可，這裡有些不確定哪一種較貼近標準寫法。

issues_zh: 盲譯寫 much greater than one would imagine，語意等同 than expected、than they imagined，英文自然，但第 2 部分「比想像中大得多」的 accepted 與參考譯文只有 than expected、than they (had) expected／imagined、than most people expect 等，沒有 than one would imagine（也沒有 than you would expect、than anyone would imagine）；建議補進 accepted。

problems: 第 2 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義
